sources.snippet: Fara1.5 is a family of native Computer Use Agents (CUAs) at three scales — Fara1.5-4B, Fara1.5-9B, and Fara1.5-27B — built on Qwen3.5 and trained with supervised finetuning on data from FaraGen1.5, our scalable data pipeline of environments, solvers, and verifiers. sources.title: Fara1.5-9B | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry - ai.azure.com
sources.snippet: Fara1.5-9B is a multimodal web agent developed by Microsoft Research AI Frontiers. It observes the browser via screenshots and acts on behalf of the user by emitting structured tool calls (click, type, scroll, web_search, visit_url, and others) to complete multi-step web tasks end-to-end.
